observation_source_encoding: artifact table index + one-based decompressed physical line

assumptions: retained files belong to one declared capture
no unobserved shared FD-table actor in connected private intervals

interface_work.argument_truncation: argument_rendering_complete describes only formatting/ellipsis; structured stat outputs remain provider renderings, not complete out values
interface_work.duration: strace -T reported decimal elapsed duration; no inferred end timestamp or cross-thread order
interface_work.importer_defect_fixed: failed execve/execveat PATH search no longer produces a missing-FD-argument gap
interface_work.outcome_scope: ordinary syscall return only; not full effects, GPU ready or device quiescence
interface_work.parameter_encoding: ordered exact numeric scalars or strace renderings; payload positions are null and explicitly listed
interface_work.timestamps: provider_line_timestamp and provider_entry_line_timestamp are strace -ttt realtime printleader stamps, never independently observed host return times; see each point_kind

validation.stability_assumption: original fragment remains stable through export

work_id_encoding: observation.work_ticket is WorkTicketID.value, not wire or a canonical operation ID
